segments.text: These are a thousand pendulums. They all started in almost exactly the same place, within a hundred-thousandth of a degree. Watch what happens.

A few seconds later, they have nothing in common. This is chaos. And it's the reason your weather app can't tell you if it'll rain two weeks from now. So I wanted to see it for myself. I programmed it from scratch, and it turned out stranger, and more beautiful, than I expected.

Let's start simple. One pendulum: a weight on a rod. Physics has understood this for four hundred years. Give it a push, and it swings back and forth, on the same path, forever. If I know where it is now, I can tell you exactly where it'll be in a thousand years. Predictable. Boring.
